body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: dadd62d13bc9ba18613be4c9911e3747b82458e1 -->
Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

**Delta evidence (hand-resolved conflict).**
- `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 1650 --reviewed 6d171bf07` class: DELTA.
- The merge of main into this branch resolved `crates/app/src/setup_post_options.rs` by hand. The remerge-diff keeps both sides. `differing()` carries main's "end units" entry (#1653) and this PR's new "between setups" entry. The message format is main's. Nothing from main was dropped.
- `git diff origin/main...dadd62d13 --stat` names only this PR's own files.

**Gate result (self-hosted pr-test runner).**
- Run: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43596474681 on head `dadd62d13`.
- Trial merge with main: clean. The head check passed.
- Quick gate: post suites ok (32 s). App suites ok (513 s), with `between_setups` 8 passed, 0 failed, and the updated `program_entry` and `setup_post_options` suites ok. Clippy on app, post, ui: clean.
- UI suites: 771 passed, 1 failed. The only failure is `egui_app::tests::setup_mount_pages::each_setup_picks_its_own_machine_and_post_and_posts_one_file_per_mount`. It fails on stock-verify warnings about the test fixture's moves. Issue 1657 tracks that main-red; the change for it (PR 1660) is under review in parallel. This PR does not cause it and it does not block this review.

**Code review.**
- `crates/app/src/posting_setup_change.rs` (new, 143 lines): folds the stop into the setup's last operation's after-action. Refuses a Go home at the change by name. A program-stop merges to one stop. The last operation of a mount gets no stop. Provenance line present.
- Engine (`crates/post/src/post/engine.rs`): a script without `afterModes` is refused once at a setup change, with words that name the next setup. The generic after-operation refusal is not repeated. The `!setup_change` guard is correct because `ask()` places `PARAM SetupChange` directly before `PARAM AfterOperation`.
- `fanuc.cps`: `G91 G28 Z0`, `G90`, then the comment naming the next setup, then M0/M1. `tormach.cps`: now declares `afterModes`; writes the machine-Z lift and `(MSG, SETUP CHANGE - NEXT: ...)`; refuses a Go home by name. `clean()` strips comment characters from the setup name, so the comment cannot break. `commentParam` only stores state, so no output echo was added.
- Project round trip: the key `post_options.between_setups` is additive, is absent at the default, and an unknown word refuses the open in both the document and the setup forms.
- Setup-owned options: the option is compared in the program-level check, so two setups that disagree are refused. One stale doc comment is noted below.
- UI: the combo queues `SetPostOptions`. Undo restores the previous value. The command law holds.
- MCP: the `post` tool takes the word and applies it first through `SetPostOptions` or `SetSetupPostOptions`. The camcraft-mcp skill row matches the tool schema. `Process change: yes` is in the body and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited. The law holds.
- No `unwrap()` or `expect()` outside tests in the changed source. Refusals name the cause. Warnings block the post at `posting.rs:590`, so no refusal is silent.
- Goldens: only `tormach/live_then_stop.refusal` changed. The afterModes warning is gone because tormach now reads the ask. The program is still refused. No NC golden changed. Confirmed in the diff stat.
- Pinning tests: the eight names match the body. The default-pause test asserts the M0 line, the comment that names the next setup, and the Z lift. The round trip test asserts the exact file words and the refusal of an unknown word. The MCP test posts, sets the choice, and undoes through the tool.
- Decision record `docs/decisions/1532-setup-boundary-stop.md` is present and complete. Changelog line present.

**Not exercised (safety floor).**
- No real control ran the output. The Fanuc and PathPilot programs are checked by text only.
- The other `afterModes` dialects (Haas, Mazak, Sinumerik, Heidenhain, others) write the stop without the Z lift and the comment. Issue 1647 tracks that.
- The UI combo was not clicked in the running app.
- The script `post` verb takes no `between_setups` argument (MCP and UI do).

**Notes (not blocking).**
- The doc comments on `program_problems()` and `differing()` in `crates/app/src/setup_post_options.rs` still list only the Output, the thread output and the End units. Please add "between setups" to those lists.
- `crates/post/src/post/engine.rs` is 596 lines. This PR adds 15 lines to a file already over the 400-line limit. Consider a split at a later point.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
